changelog: v2.9.55: AetherPOS Register & Terminal Add-on — full-screen touch register with 4 built-in themes (Midnight, Modern Light, Artisan Café, Classic Retail), dual-pane catalog & live ticket, instant change calculator, thermal receipt printing, and daily shift sales reports
v2.9.54: Critical fix for admin studio & public canvas module syntax error on bootstrap

v2.9.53: SEO Pre-Flight Audit recognizes Portfolio Showcase & Custom Add-ons as full Hero elements — dynamic <h1> template & DOM detection, profile avatar alt validation, and registered Portfolio Showcase in Addon Library

v2.9.52: Robust Custom CSS parser & @keyframes support — seamless support for complex animations (e.g. Christmas festive lights, multi-stop radial gradients), unscoped keyframe preservation, media queries, and standalone export bundling

v2.9.51: Interactive deep-linking for Pre-Publish SEO & Health Pre-Flight Audit — 1-click Jump to Widget pinpoint navigation, canvas glow pulse, auto-filtered Inspector property focus, and direct Page/Site settings deep-linking
v2.9.50: Infinite Gallery Marquee add-on — fixed tooltip headroom clipping, plus optional live sync via Google Sheets (CSV) and MySQL / REST API data sources
v2.9.49: Chat Assistant & Guided Tour addons automatically respect fixed bottom footer via dynamic --footer-offset detection, breathing room padding, and smart vertical stacking
v2.9.48: Fixed Client & Staff Portal Dashboard login authentication pipeline (emulation endpoints, CORS X-Portal-Token, session_start, and Content-Type headers)

v2.9.47: Client & Staff Portal Dashboard add-on — full-screen authenticated management portal with role-based access, live registration tracking, status workflows, private staff notes, CSV export, MySQL auto-schema, and staff user management
v2.9.46: Full-Page Studio mode & accidental close protection for Add-On Maker and Chatbot Flowchart editor, plus clean universal business starter flow replacing legacy MCLE samples
v2.9.45: Universal Inspector Search Bar — cleanly docked directly below the floating Content/Style/Advanced tabs; instantly filters all widget properties, settings, and repeater items in realtime

v2.9.44: Fixed step title & explanation display with multi-field fallback (title/stepTitle/targetLabel & content/explanation/description), bulletproof auto-close on last step timeout, and Admin Studio (?view=admin) cross-page navigation detection
v2.9.43: Timed Tour Steps with sleek visual progress bar, hover-pause & visitor opt-out toggle (⏸️/▶️), plus Smart Resume on Reopen (remembers unfinished step & launcher badge with ↺ Restart option)
v2.9.42: Teacher & Board Mascot positioning with dynamic height/boundary detector + idle breathing & subtle sway animation when voiceover ends
v2.9.41: Optional tour screen recorder — records browser tab + mascot, saves WebM/MP4 on tour end
v2.9.40: Global Tour — tour now injects across all pages like the navbar; added SPA navigateToPage() for smooth cross-page step transitions
v2.9.39: Cross-page Tour steps — Pick Element dropdown now surfaces nav menu items and other-page sections; added navigateToUrl step field
v2.9.38: Fixed double-hash ## bug in Element Picker; auto-sanitize custom element IDs
v2.9.37: Per-step mascot avatar override support; step avatar height and style controls
v2.9.36: Interactive Tour Pro — global avatar, voice-over, auto-advance on audio end
